meta_description:
163K likes, 2,801 comments - unfitofit_official_ on October 13, 2024: "🇮🇳 🥇🥇🥈🥈Asian championship 2024 

End of the season with 4 medals in 4 events

2 gold medals 🥇🥇
2 silver medals 🥈🥈

Oh! My god the thrilll , i usually enjoy this thrill but dudeeee this time was different . I was literally scared , scared asf , but I believe - 
Kisi se bhi nah darna apko bahadur nahi banata hai 
Per darte hue bhi us kaam ko poore dil ke sath karna apko bahadur banata hai 🇮🇳❤️

Thank you sooo much @its_piyushkr without you even dreaming about this was impossible , thank you @gymnastics_funda_with_sushil for your mentorship , thank you @rlif.ts for all those early morning sessions :)

Still a long way to go 🚶‍♀️ 

Thanks for all your love & blessing 

Dhanyawad 🥋🥊❤️

Tags - asian championship , champion , gold medal , asian games , kickboxing 

#asiangames #goldmedal #champion".
